unavailable: The scanner is not installed, so Cleaner can't work on this system.
hero.scan.title: See what's taking your space
hero.scan.line: A scan only reads. Nothing changes until you confirm it.
estimateNote: An estimate: hard links, open files, compression and snapshots change what is really freed.
incomplete: This scan is incomplete: more may exist than is shown here.
incomplete.files: This scan is incomplete: it reached the limit of items it examines.
incomplete.depth: This scan is incomplete: some folders are too deep to examine.
incomplete.nodes: This scan is incomplete: there are more folders than it keeps.
incomplete.results: Only the largest files found so far are listed.
emptyHint: This scan found nothing to clean.
cleanup.title: Cleanup
empty.title: Empty the Trash?
empty.detail: Everything in the Trash, on every disk, is deleted. This can't be undone.
confirm.lineDelete: Delete {n} rebuildable files, {size}. This can't be undone.
confirm.lineTrash: Move {n} to the Trash, {size}. Their space stays in use.
confirm.lineLeft: Leave {n} alone: they changed or can't be touched.
warn.linksElsewhere: Some have hard links elsewhere, so their space stays in use.
warn.keepOneCopy: Every selected copy of a file was left: one must stay.
reason.skipped: Skipped, newer than the rule allows or the last copy: {n}
reason.unsupported: This action doesn't apply to them: {n}
trashNote: Items in the Trash can be restored below or from Files.
error.protocol: The scanner sent something invalid, so its results were discarded.
error.sandbox: The scanner could not lock itself in, so it did not run.
hero.large.title: Find what's big and old
hero.large.line: Filter your largest files by size, age and type.
large.title: Large files
hero.storage.title: See your disk at a glance
hero.storage.line: Pick a volume and map where the space goes.
map.hint: Click an area to see what it is.
hero.dups.title: Find exact copies
hero.dups.line: Choose folders. Copies are compared by their content.
dups.title: Duplicates
dups.hint: Choose the copies to remove. Nothing is selected for you.
dups.none: No exact copies in these folders.
activity.title: Activity
activity.privacy: Counts and sizes only: no paths are kept.
prefs.title: Settings
prefs.excludeHint: Relative to your home folder. They are skipped by every scan.
rule.thumbnails: Image thumbnails. They are created again the next time a folder is shown.
rule.fontconfig: The font cache. It is rebuilt when fonts are next used.
rule.shader-cache: Compiled graphics shaders. They are compiled again when needed.
rule.shader-db: The database of compiled graphics shaders. It is rebuilt when needed.
rule.media-registry: The list of media plugins. It is rebuilt the next time media plays.
rule.temporary: Temporary files older than a week. Check them first: they go to the Trash.
rule.trash: Items in the Trash. Empty the Trash to free their space.
blocked.busy: Skipped while this browser is open. Close it and scan again.
models.warn: Other apps may use these and would download them again:
system.journalText: Trims the system journal to its newest 200 MB.
system.aptText: Package files left in the system's download folder.
system.vartmpText: Files of the system over 30 days old and not in use.
system.confirm: This asks for administrator rights and can't be undone.
rule.lordos-thumbnails: Previews LordOS made for Files and Photos. They're made again when shown.
rule.pip: Packages kept by pip. It downloads them again when needed.
rule.npm: npm's download cache, fetched again when needed.
rule.yarn: Yarn's download cache, fetched again when needed.
rule.go-build: Compiled output that Go rebuilds on the next build.
rule.pnpm-store: Projects link into this store, so moving it can break them until they reinstall.
rule.firefox-cache: Saved web pages and images. Profiles, cookies and passwords are not touched.
rule.firefox-startup: Rebuilt the next time the browser starts.
rule.chromium-cache: Saved web pages and images. Profiles, cookies and passwords are not touched.
rule.chromium-code: Compiled page scripts, rebuilt on the next visit.
rule.chromium-gpu: Rebuilt when pages are next drawn.
rule.chromium-shader: Compiled graphics shaders, rebuilt when needed.
rule.chromium-grshader: Compiled drawing shaders, rebuilt when needed.
rule.chrome-cache: Saved web pages and images. Profiles, cookies and passwords are not touched.
rule.chrome-code: Compiled page scripts, rebuilt on the next visit.
rule.chrome-gpu: Rebuilt when pages are next drawn.
rule.chrome-shader: Compiled graphics shaders, rebuilt when needed.
rule.partial-downloads: Partial files over a week old in Downloads.
rule.partial-downloads-chromium: Partial browser downloads over a week old.
rule.crash-system: Reports over a week old, kept after a program failed.
rule.crash-firefox: Reports over a week old from a Firefox-based browser.
rule.crash-chromium: Reports over a week old from Chromium.
rule.logs-display: Previous display server logs over a month old.
rule.ai-huggingface: One folder per model. Choose each one: other apps may use it and would download it again.
rule.ai-huggingface-partial: Partial files that a new download replaces. Chosen one by one.
rule.ai-lmstudio: One folder per model. Choose each one.
rule.ai-lmstudio-old: One folder per model. Choose each one.
rule.ai-ollama: Models share their files here, so remove them from Ollama itself.
rule.old-downloads: Files over 90 days old in Downloads. Shown so you can decide.
rule.containers: Size and location only: use the container tool to clean it.
rule.trash-disks: Items in the Trash of your other disks. Empty the Trash to free their space.
confirm.rowLeft: {n} left alone: they changed or can't be touched
confirm.noteTrash: Files in the Trash keep using space until it is emptied.
panel.word.good: In good shape: plenty of disk space
